_read_me: YOUR settings. The desk sizes positions and blocks trades using these numbers. capital = null means 'not set': sizing then shows per-unit risk only and the risk gate warns. Costs below were copied on 2026-11-11 from each broker's official pricing page (coindcx.com/fees, indmoney.com/pricing, enrichmoney.in/pricing). Re-check them if your broker announces a change.

crypto._source: CoinDCX spot crypto-to-crypto (C2C) pairs, Regular level: 0.17% maker and taker, +18% GST on fees
crypto._tds_note: 1% TDS on sells is not a cost (credited against your tax) but it ties up cash until you file your return
crypto._tax_note: India VDA rules as understood on 2026-11-11: 30% tax + 4% cess on crypto profits, losses cannot be set off. Confirm with your CA.

us._source: INDmoney Plan A: 0.25% per trade (max $25), +18% GST; SEC 0.00206% on sells; IFSCA turnover fee 0.005% incl. GST; FINRA TAF waived to 2026-12-31
us._fx_note: INR<->USD conversion cost is paid when you deposit or withdraw, not on each trade, so it is not counted per trade

nse_intraday._source: Enrich Money equity intraday: 0.02% brokerage, STT 0.025% sell, NSE txn 0.00297%, clearing 0.0025%, SEBI 0.0001%, stamp 0.003% buy, GST 18%

nse_swing._source: Enrich Money equity delivery: 0.2% brokerage, STT 0.1% both sides, NSE txn 0.00297%, clearing 0.0025%, SEBI 0.0001%, stamp 0.015% buy, DP Rs15 + Rs5.50 CDSL per sell, GST 18%

forex._source: Enrich Money NSE currency futures: 0.02% brokerage, NSE txn 0.0009%, clearing 0.0015%, SEBI 0.0001%, stamp 0.0001% buy, GST 18%, no STT

budget._why: Each full debate uses about 10 AI agent calls. These limits keep the 24/7 runs inside your Claude plan.

volatility._why: When a market is far more jumpy than usual, stops get hit by noise and gaps. Size is cut automatically.

paper._why: A practice account with fake money that takes every final TAKE call, to measure the desk before real money.
